report.overall: WETH9 implements a minimal wrapped Ether contract using direct storage updates for balances and allowances with no privileged roles or upgrade paths. All state changes are accompanied by events and the withdraw function follows checks-effects-interactions before the external call. Slither reports zero high or medium findings.

checklist.note: No owner, admin, or role-restricted functions present in the contract.
No proxy, delegatecall, or upgrade logic in the source.
withdraw updates balanceOf before msg.sender.transfer and transferFrom updates balances before the final Transfer event.
No oracle or price feed usage in the code.
balanceOf updates guarded by require(balanceOf[src] >= wad) before subtraction; no unchecked math beyond direct +=/-=.
Only msg.sender.transfer(wad) after state update; no other external calls.
No signatures or permit-style functions in the contract.
No pause, circuit-breaker, or emergency-stop logic present.
approve and transferFrom implement the standard allowance pattern including the uint(-1) infinite allowance check.
Deposit, Withdrawal, Approval, and Transfer events are emitted on every state-changing operation.

report.overall: TetherToken implements a pausable, blacklistable ERC20 with owner-controlled fees, issuance, redemption and an upgrade/deprecation path to an UpgradedStandardToken. All 15 Medium Slither findings are erc20-interface mismatches caused by onlyPayloadSize modifiers, fee logic and the deprecated forwarding paths present in BasicToken.transfer, StandardToken.transferFrom/approve and TetherToken overrides. No High-severity issues were reported.

checklist.note: Ownable.onlyOwner protects transferOwnership, pause, unpause, add/removeBlackList, destroyBlackFunds, deprecate, issue, redeem and setParams.
deprecated flag and upgradedAddress forward calls to UpgradedStandardToken; no proxy pattern or storage layout guarantees are present in the source.
No external calls to untrusted contracts inside state-changing functions; all transfers are internal balance updates.
No oracles or price feeds in the provided TetherToken.sol.
SafeMath used for all balance and supply operations; onlyPayloadSize guards are applied.
When deprecated, transfer/transferFrom/approve forward to UpgradedStandardToken at an owner-supplied address with no reentrancy or interface checks.
No signatures or permit functions in the source.
Pausable.whenNotPaused guards all transfer paths; onlyOwner can pause/unpause.
approve contains the classic race-condition mitigation but still allows unlimited allowances; MAX_UINT special case exists in transferFrom.
Transfer, Approval, Pause, Unpause, Added/RemovedBlackList, DestroyedBlackFunds, Issue, Redeem, Deprecate and Params are emitted.

slither_triage.why: All 15 Medium findings stem from onlyPayloadSize modifiers, fee subtraction and the deprecated forwarding branches in BasicToken.transfer, StandardToken.transferFrom/approve and TetherToken overrides; these are intentional deviations from the plain ERC20 interface declared in ERC20Basic/ERC20.

r, s, v are declared but only read inside the EOA branch; the contract-signature branch never uses them, matching the source in SignatureVerification.sol.
